'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023-present)]]
**[[Syrian civil war]]
***[[US intervention in the Syrian civil war]]
****American special forces carry out a raid in Northern Syria and kills an ISIS leader with the reported assistance of Syrian government forces. The slain ISIS leader was purportedly in succession to succeed as the caliph of ISIS's Syrian branch. [https://www.foxnews.com/us/us-military-raid-syria-eliminates-isis-leader-waiting-key-financier-officials (Fox News)] 
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli invasion of Gaza]]
****[[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Israeli defense minister]] [[Israel Katz]] approves [[2025 Gaza City offensive|a planned ground invasion to seize control]] of [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-864732 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern front of the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***A [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[Multiple rocket launcher|MLRS]] rocket strike on a market in [[Kostiantynivka]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], kills three people and injures four others, according to [[Governor of Donetsk Oblast|Governor]] [[Vadym Filashkin]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/three-killed-russian-shelling-key-eastern-ukrainian-city-local-officials-say-2025-08-20/ (Reuters)]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***Shortly after midnight, a [[Russia]]n [[drone warfare|military drone]] explodes when crashing in [[Osiny, Puławy County|Osiny]], [[Puławy County]], [[Poland]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2025/08/20/suspected-military-drone-crashes-and-explodes-in-eastern-poland-officials-say (Euronews)] [https://tvn24.pl/polska/mon-mamy-do-czynienia-z-rosyjskim-dronem-prowokacja-st8608372 (TVN24 <small>in Polish</small>)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**The {{ill|Guatemalan Immigration Institute|es|Instituto Guatemalteco de Migración}} grants temporary [[Humanitarian visa|humanitarian status]] to 161 [[Mexicans|Mexican]] nationals, including 92 adults and 69 children from [[Chiapas]], allowing them to remain legally in [[Guatemala]] after fleeing cartel-related violence in the [[Guatemala–Mexico border|border]] municipality of [[Frontera Comalapa]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/americas/guatemala-agrees-to-shelter-161-mexicans-fleeing-violence-in-southern-mexico/3665060 (Anadolu Agency)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least two people are killed and two others are injured in a [[rockfall]] on the [[Égratz Viaduct]] in [[Chamonix]], [[Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes]], [[France]]. [https://www.ledauphine.com/faits-divers-justice/2025/08/20/un-eboulement-fait-des-victimes-dans-les-egratz-a-passy (''Le Dauphiné libéré'' <small>in French</small>)]
*One person is killed and 19 others are injured, including three seriously, after a migrant shipwreck is found drifting off the southern coast of [[Mallorca]], [[Spain]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2025/08/20/one-dead-and-19-injured-after-migrant-shipwreck-found-drifting-off-mallorca (Euronews)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–India relations]]
**[[India]] and [[China]] agree to resume direct flights suspended [[2020–2021 China–India skirmishes|since 2020]], reopen designated [[Sino-Indian border dispute|border]] trade points and boost investment in their economies following talks in [[New Delhi]] between [[Foreign Minister of China|Chinese foreign minister]] [[Wang Yi]] and Indian officials, including [[Prime Minister of India|Indian prime minister]] [[Narendra Modi]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/india-china-agree-resume-direct-flights-boost-business-links-2025-08-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Kyrgyzstan–United Kingdom relations]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] imposes [[United Kingdom sanctions|sanctions]] on eight individuals and entities accused of helping [[Russia]] evade [[Western world|Western]] sanctions through [[Financial network|financial]] and [[cryptocurrency]] networks, including [[Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyz]] firms linked to the [[Digital ruble|ruble]]-pegged [[stablecoin]] A7A5. [[President of Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyz president]] [[Sadyr Japarov]] has appealed to the UK regarding the sanctions. [https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/kyrgyzstan-appeals-trump-starmer-after-uk-imposes-russia-related-sanctions-2025-08-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[United States and the International Criminal Court]]
**The [[United States Department of State]] imposes [[United States government sanctions|sanctions]] on [[International Criminal Court]] judges [[Nicolas Guillou]] and [[Kimberly Prost]] and deputy prosecutors [[Nazhat Shameem]] and {{Ill|Mame Mandiaye Niang|es}} over their involvement in cases concerning [[Israel]] and the [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/trump-administration-imposes-new-sanctions-four-icc-judges-prosecutors-2025-08-20/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 New Zealand espionage case]]
**A [[New Zealand]] [[court-martial]] sentences a [[New Zealand Defence Force|soldier]] to two years in [[military prison]] and orders his [[Military discharge|discharge]] after he pleads guilty to attempted [[Foreign espionage in New Zealand|espionage]], possession of banned material, and unauthorized access to a military computer system, marking the country's first conviction for spying. [https://apnews.com/article/soldier-white-nationalist-espionage-new-zealand-sentence-c04660d4155e770aef7006aaf4e7f200 (AP)]
*A man is detained on suspicion of [[Murder in French law|murder]] after four bodies were found in the [[Seine]] river in [[Choisy-le-Roi]], [[Île-de-France]], France. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5yer12rp8po (BBC News)]
*[[Mexico City]] [[List of heads of government of Mexico City|mayor]] [[Clara Brugada]] announces the arrest of 13 people, including three alleged gunmen, in connection with the [[List of politicians killed during the presidency of Claudia Sheinbaum#2025|May shooting]] that killed her personal secretary and an adviser. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/8/20/authorities-arrest-13-suspects-over-killing-of-mexico-city-officials (Al Jazeera)]
*At least 19 people are hospitalized following a clash between [[Club Universidad de Chile]] and [[Club Atlético Independiente]] fans during a [[2025 Copa Sudamericana final stages|round of 16]] match of the [[2025 Copa Sudamericana]] [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cm2k5jegdjko (BBC)] [https://www.marca.com/en/football/2025/08/21/68a7087d46163fcc6a8b456c.html (''Marca'')]
